reviews.text: Lovely staff. Very professional. Colm looked after my hamster and my my dog.

Honestly if I could give these gives more stars I would. No matter what always there to help. Just today I needed to bring my cocker spanial Vader to be checked urgently as he had a nasty cut on his ear and they got me in immeadiately to see the vet. She put my mind at ease and took such good care of Vader. I bring both my dogs here and simply can't reccomend them enough.
Couldn't recommend more, the vets are so kind and knowledgeable. I'd find it hard to bring my dog anywhere else
Vets and staff are so knowledgeable and kind. Amazing with animals

I have been blown away by the kindness of Colm and especially Denis who have saved the life of my little dog Belle not once but twice and showed so much compassion to her and ME , the best Veterinary Clinic EVER , forever grateful 🙏 olive Walsh …
Lovely friendly practice, Denis and Colm are excellent vets offering superb advice and petcare.
Amazing Vets and Staff. Very professional and reliable. The best in Dublin so far I could find for my cats. I really recommend Bull Wall!
Very good veterinary practice. Very kind staff.

Denis and Colm are wonderful vets and have helped keep my beloved Cocker Spaniel pain free and happy for almost 3 years after I was told by another vet that she should be put to sleep.  I am so grateful that I took the advise of a neighbour and got a second opinion.  Sadly Val had to be put to sleep after her condition began to cause her discomfort and I decided to have a home visit so she could pass in her own bed, Colm was kind and gentle and even though I am heart broken I am greatly comforted knowing she received the best care possible and her passing was peaceful.
Top class Vet with a vocational and holistic approach to animal welfare.
Cannot say enough about the care Denis and his team have provided to us over the years - beyond 5 stars!!  Thank you!
The best place ever

Denis Shannon is the one of the best vets I have ever had the pleasure to deal with hands down.

Denis even followed up with a phone call to check on my dog unprompted. Lovely caring vet and very knowledgeable. Denis has cared for my cats, dogs, birds and rabbit like they were his own animals.

I have also dealt with Colm, another excellent caring, knowledgeable vet.

Overall excellent service with helpful, caring staff to add to the excellent service. I cannot say a bad word about this vet from the gecko excellent.

I would like to thank Dennis / Colm and the Team for their love and careing over 8 years for our Germany Shepherd Hercules  . A great boy who loved to go to see Dennis because he knew he was being so well Looked After. Hercules passes away suddenly and peacefully on Monday 15” December.  Surrounded by Love .Robert Laura Jack
Just terrific service here thanks you.

I cannot recommend Bull Wall Vet enough. Colm has been so good to our dog. They are knowledgeable, responsive, caring, and treat our dog like their own. The very best.
Faultless!

My cat had a sore and needed to be seen. Bull Wall scheduled us in as soon as they could and were very helpful. The cat was very stressed out and wouldn't go in to the carrier. Vet Meabh was so calming and put her so at ease, even carried her too and from the car. She handled her so well and was so calm and productive through the whole appointment. Could not recommend highly enough!

I couldn't praise this vets enough, they were the only ones around who would look at my child's guinea pig, all the other vets I rang said that they don't take exotic animals. Colm didn't rush into suggesting an operation and gave me advice on trying to maintain the problem myself, however when this didn't work he fitted me in and did the operation straight away. He was extremely compassionate and I felt, for all that was entailed, they were very reasonably priced.
First time there everything was great staff lovely dog was relaxed as well so very pleased .

This is a fantastic Vetinary clinic. The vet, Colum, and all his team of nurses are absolutely lovely and very kind to animals. They genuinely care about their patients. I’ve been to a few veterinary clinics but I wouldn’t go to another vet unless the animal needed specialist treatment.

This veterinary clinic is truly outstanding. My cat loves it here just as much as I do. Masai is very fond of Colm—he remains calm around him and doesn’t scratch like he does with other doctors. I believe he senses that Colm is a genuinely kind person. The senior doctor—whose name I unfortunately forgot, but I believe he is the owner—is also extremely polite and sincere. Warm regards to the receptionist (with short hair), who is always cheerful and helpful. I will never switch to another vet for my cat!
Very experienced clinic with lovely staff.
